nuggets.text: Bo Nix started 61 college games at Auburn and Oregon, the most by a quarterback in NCAA history.
Bo Nix set an NFL record with 12 comeback wins in 2025, the most ever by a quarterback in one season.
Bo Nix has a career receiving touchdown, caught on a trick play thrown by receiver Courtland Sutton.
After a 1-2 start in 2025, the Broncos won 11 straight games on the way to the AFC West title.
Sean Payton played quarterback for the Chicago Bears as a replacement player during the 1987 players' strike.
Before coaching, Sean Payton played quarterback in England for the Leicester Panthers in 1988.
Sean Payton's Eastern Illinois teams threw the ball so much they were nicknamed 'Eastern Airlines.'
Jaylen Waddle and Pat Surtain II were roommates at Alabama and were drafted just three picks apart in 2021.
The Broncos' live mascot Thunder, a gray Arabian horse, gallops the length of the field after every touchdown and field goal.
Bucky the Bronco, the 30-foot horse atop the Broncos' scoreboard, is a replica of Roy Rogers' horse Trigger.
